clips.title: The story
paras: In Northshire Valley, Marshal McBride sends The Adventurer toward Goldshire to find Sam Sarsaparilla. You have shown your skill defending the abbey, and McBride wants you to look into the newcomer.

As threats from the local Defias and vermin ease, Marshal McBride turns his attention to the road beyond Northshire Valley. Stormwind's regular forces are stretched thin across the kingdom, so the local garrison relies on promising fighters to watch travelers and wanderers in the surrounding woods.

Marshal McBride asks you to check on Sam Sarsaparilla, a newcomer spotted near Goldshire. It is an unusual request, not a military order or a bounty hunt, and it leads you from Northshire's secluded valley into the wider wilds of Elwynn Forest.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Friend, you have proven your competence as a protector thus far. That is why I am now entrusting you with an unusual task.
I've heard of a new adventurer down the road by Goldshire. Go and see what he's doing.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I appreciate the lookin' out, adventurer. That marshal's just a worrywart.
Hey, you've got the look of an adventurer yourself. How would you like to learn about camping?
